name: Go subscriptions
summary: Quillwork, a team plan sold through Stripe Checkout: a Go app on net/http, html/template and Postgres whose Stripe webhook starts the plan and sends a welcome email through Resend.
runsOn: A Go server in Chromium, with Postgres in Docker
shows: A Go app behind danwo's proxy with no Node preload: Go's own HTTPS_PROXY support, and danwo's CA trusted through the SSL_CERT_FILE danwo sets, on Linux and macOS
The official Stripe and Resend Go SDKs against the emulators, a webhook verified with the Stripe SDK and deduped in the activation's transaction
Invariants that read both sides: one plan per Stripe subscription with Stripe's status, and one welcome email per team
`danwo matrix` faulting Stripe, Resend, the webhooks and Postgres (36 trials), and `QUILLWORK_BUG` switches the matrix catches
